## Changes

### New
- Explore keeps its header and filters at the top while the results scroll. Search sits behind a button, as in Bookmarks, and opens right away from Home's search button.
- The reader's chapter list marks chapters you read: finished ones are faint with a check, started ones show their page.
- More is regrouped into Sources, Library, Sync, Backup and Appearance. Migrate source moves to Sources and imports to Backup; Sync has its own section and asks before disconnecting Google Drive. Clear cache shows its size and Check for updates the version.

### Fixes
- Scrolling a chapter is smoother: pages keep their height while their image loads again, instead of jumping.
- Zoomed in, a small flick no longer scrolls pages away.
- Chapters whose last pages are short (credit pages) are marked read at the end.
- A chapter left on its end card no longer shows page 14 of 13.
- macOS: the app no longer crashes when opening a WebView with several extensions installed.
- macOS: the app icon matches the size of other Mac icons.
